session/new materializes on disk; session/list returns a flat array with _meta; session/load after respawn replays history as session/update notifications in 0.45 s
permission machine fail-closed: unknown optionId, malformed reply shape, reject and cancel all fail the tool call without execution
allow_always caches per tool name per session (blanket within a session, not across sessions)
fd1 strictly NDJSON across 211 frames and ~21 process lifetimes; clean stdin EOF exits 0 in 0.04 s
timings: prompt to first session/update ~50 ms against the loopback mock; permission round trip sub-millisecond
edges_found: one malformed stdin JSON line kills the server silently: exit code 0 in ~32 ms, no error frame, no log entry - a client must watchdog the child and never trust exit code 0
documented custom error codes (-32000/-32002/-32003) never surface; unknown method, unknown session and failed session/load all funnel to -32603 with data.details strings
no sessionBusy on the prompt path: a second same-session prompt cancels-and-replaces (in-flight resolves stopReason cancelled in 8 ms)

provider config schema stricter than its docs (cost.cacheRead/cacheWrite required); rejection is a log-file WARN only and turns silently reroute to discovery (an embedding model was selected as chat default on the probe machine)
no epochs or sequence numbers on the event stream; reconciliation is respawn plus session/load replay

lapis_relevant_findings.backpressure: lapis already has the omp mechanics (append-then-pause reader, bounded drain with zero-timer re-arms, harvest-pressure pause); the 64 KiB overflow stop is a defensive invariant. Zero-compromises direction: raise transient budgets, harden the overflow branch to pause-and-wait, keep pause-reader only for genuine sink exhaustion.
lapis_relevant_findings.tui_scheduling: omp's scheduler independently derives the policy lapis codifies as the update-pacing contract (elapsed-time min-interval, newest-wins, burst coalescing), plus adaptive frame-cost floor, output-backlog gate, input grace scoped to interrupt keys, and demand-armed ticks for time-derived presentation.
lapis_relevant_findings.attention: lapis already has priority tiers with aging, revision dedupe, snooze/cooldown and fail-closed bounds; net-new is a 3-rule advisory-only emission guard (content-normalized suppression across IDs, per-window budget with reported overflow, escalation-only re-announcement) scoped to empty-choice notices.
lapis_relevant_findings.crates: pi-diff (zero-dep jsdiff-v9 parity), pi-vfs (provider-trait seam) and pi-walker vendor cleanly into Rust projects (ccr-rust candidates); the pi-edit hashline protocol is the top design-port. No lapis C++ dependency.
lapis_relevant_findings.routing: error/rate-limit taxonomy, fallback-chain grammar, wait-merge fail-fast and credential rotation are ccr-rust ports, not lapis.
